protocol.description: Reserved to the Silica shell components (Dock, menu bar, Faro): the global is visible only to them. Windows are listed with ext-foreign-toplevel-list-v1; this protocol adds what the shell asks of the compositor.

request.name: activate

description.summary: brings a window to the front

request.description: The window with this identifier (the identifier event of ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1) gets the focus and goes above the others; if it is minimized, it comes back where it was. An unknown identifier does nothing.

event.name: focused
event.description: The identifier (ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.identifier) of the window that has the keyboard focus, or an empty string if no window has it. Sent on binding and on every change.

request.name: execute
request.description: A parameterless command of Ossido's catalog (the same one used by shortcuts, the control channel and MCP), for example faro.toggle from the bar's magnifier.

event.name: command
event.description: A catalog command that belongs to a shell component (for example faro.toggle): Ossido forwards it to all of them; each one answers its own.

request.name: launch

description.summary: starts an app as a client of the session

request.description: The command (POSIX shell syntax, already without the Exec field codes) becomes a child process of Ossido, like app.launch on the control channel.

event.name: minimized

description.summary: a window was minimized or restored

event.description: The window with this identifier was minimized (minimized 1) or restored (0). On binding all minimized windows are sent, in the order they were minimized; then on every change. The Dock puts them next to the Trash.

request.name: thumbnail

description.summary: the thumbnail of a minimized window

request.description: Ossido writes into the file the window thumbnail (8-bit premultiplied RGBA, rows from the top, no padding between rows), taken when it was minimized, at most 256 pixels per side; then it sends the thumbnail event. The file must be writable and at least 256 × 256 × 4 bytes large.

event.name: thumbnail

description.summary: the thumbnail is in the file

event.description: Width and height of the thumbnail written into the file; 0 and 0 if the window is not minimized or has no thumbnail.

event.name: window_menu

description.summary: the arrangement popover of a window

event.description: Long press on the full-screen button of the window with this identifier: the shell opens the arrangement popover (move and resize, fill and arrange, full screen) with the tip towards the point x, y (logical screen coordinates, below the button). The entries run the window.tile_* commands on the focused window.

request.name: broadcast

description.summary: a state for the other shell components

request.description: A component announces a state to the others (for example the open Control Center, which the bar shows with the capsule on its icon): Ossido sends it back to every shell component with the broadcast event, sender included, and remembers it for whoever binds later.

event.name: broadcast

description.summary: the state announced by a component

event.description: On binding the last value of every topic, then on every announcement.

request.name: execute_with

description.summary: runs a catalog command with parameters

request.description: Like execute, with the parameters in JSON (an object): for example screenshot.region with the rectangle chosen in the crosshair.

enum.name: outside

description.summary: what an input outside an open transient does

enum.description: Provisional defaults (until the reference's INPUT-01 measurement): presses outside a menu are consumed, presses outside a panel (Faro, Control Center, Notification Center) reach what is below. The pointer's hover always reaches the surfaces below.

entry.name: consume
entry.summary: it closes the transient and does nothing else

entry.name: pass_through
entry.summary: it closes the transient and also reaches what is below

request.name: set_transient

description.summary: a menu or panel of this surface is open

request.description: While a transient is open the surface keeps an input region as small as the menu or panel itself: the other windows keep receiving the pointer (hover, cursor shapes). A button press outside the transient makes Ossido send dismissed; then, per press, the press is consumed or delivered to what is under the pointer. Scrolling outside is delivered or dropped per scroll, without dismissing. A press on the surface itself (or its subsurfaces and popups) counts as inside, as does one inside region (surface coordinates; null: only the surface itself). Setting it again replaces the previous transient of the same surface. Keyboard routing stays with the layer surface's keyboard interactivity, which the shell sets while the transient is open.

request.name: clear_transient

description.summary: the transient of this surface is closed

request.description: The shell closed it itself (Esc, a choice, a toggle): no dismissed event follows.

event.name: dismissed

description.summary: a press outside closed the transient

event.description: The transient of this surface ended because of a press outside it; the shell closes the menu or panel. Sent once; the transient is already cleared.
